args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was on **v2.3.1** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks (error rate 0.18).
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — confirmed `rolled_out`/`VERIFIED`.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` for checkout-api (on-call paged), describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0.

**Post-rollback verification:**
- checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback went to a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
